system.flavor:
Keep a wounded friend steady through the surgeon's work, a long walk on a bad leg, or an interrogation that leans on the wound. They hold their tongue and their footing. Threats and pain do not get the say they want.

Not enough to close the wound or protect anyone from a fresh one.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one non-Critical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn; grant +1 Composure against pain and hostile influence for that duration.

surges.html: Extend suppression through the end of your next turn.
The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Vow
rider.html: Vow: neither you nor the target voluntarily moves farther from the other before your next turn. Spend this Authority when the target is pushed to resist 2 units; breaking the Vow discards it.
